Bacteria found in the human intestine capable of improving muscle strength
item.description:
📝 Relationship between gut bacteria and muscle performance The team analyzed whether certain gut microbes are associated with muscle strength and physical condition. In young adults, greater abundance of this bacterium is associated with both greater handgrip strength and higher cardiorespiratory capacity. Roseburia inulinivorans increases muscle strength.
